content.text: In the series of outdoor picnic activities for students of the School of Cardinals, TodayTourist hosted the experience program with the theme “TICK TO GROW UPW – where they both play and learn meaningful living skills.

Teams in turn conquer many interesting testing stations such as: campaigning, observing, listening, creating, mobilizing... every time you complete your mission, you will receive a special item such as: matchboxes, rice, eggs, sticks...

content.alt: TO GROW UP – GROW GIVING TRIRE

content.text: Those seemingly simple items were the ingredients for teams to prepare their meals together in the activity “I went into the kitchen together.
Through this journey, you have learned:
The Spirit of Unity and Group Work
Skills to Serve and Share With Friends
It's not just a picnic, it's a journey that helps them practice their life skills – learn how to grow through trials.
TodayTourist is honored to be on the same school as the school in the student's meaningful experiences.
TODAYYURIST – Co-walking Future Generation Experiences and Education
